# Kopparpriset på nytt rekord – Kanada höjer tullarna mot USA

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-08  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon covered a quiet day of global markets: US markets were closed and Asian tech stocks were rising. Other themes were a stronger yen ahead of an expected Bank of Japan rate hike, record copper prices driven by fears of US tariffs and a US–Canada tariff dispute that has mixed effects on SSAB. The hosts also warned that rising wheat and fertiliser prices could push up inflation and interest rates and weigh on equities. There was little Swedish company news: a Citi target-price raise on Atlas Copco, insider buying in Karnell, a Skanska order and the date for SKF's automotive spin-off.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 BOL — Boliden | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

High copper exposure while copper hits records on tariff fears and structural demand from data centres and power grids.

#### Reasoning

The hosts link record copper prices, backwardation from pulling shipments forward before expected US tariffs on refined copper, and structural demand (US/China data centres, Chinese grids, European build-out) to copper-exposed miners such as Boliden. This is a thematic mention, not an explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if copper prices reverse once US tariff front-loading ends
- if data centre or grid build-out slows

> *"Ja, och Boliden också, hög exponering."*

---

### 🟠 LUMI — Lundin Mining | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Stock has underperformed, but record copper is 'very good' for this copper-heavy miner.

#### Reasoning

The host notes Lundin Mining has lagged but says record copper prices are very good for it given its heavy copper exposure. This is a thematic positive comment, not an explicit recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the copper price rally reverses
- if backwardation eases after US tariffs take effect

> *"Jag såg att Lundin Mining har inte gått så himla bra, men det här är jättebra för dem."*

---

### 🟠 SSAB-B — SSAB | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

The US–Canada tariff dispute cuts both ways for SSAB; the hosts will keep an eye on the share price.

#### Reasoning

US tariffs on Canadian steel should be net positive because SSAB produces in the US. Canadian countertariffs on US steel make SSAB's exports to Canada more expensive. A previous deal headline sent the stock down 7%. The hosts only say they will watch the price.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a US–Canada deal removes steel tariffs
- if Canadian countertariffs hit SSAB's US exports

> *"Vi får hålla koll på kursen i alla fall."*

---

### 🟠 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Citi (a cited analyst) raised the price target to 256 from 245.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst action (Citi), not the hosts' own view. The hosts made no further comment.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Citi or other analysts cut estimates

> *"City har hängt Atlas Copco till 256 från 245."*

---

### 🟠 KARNEL-B — Karnell | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Chairman and other board members bought shares.

#### Reasoning

Insider buying by the chairman and other board members is a positive signal of insider confidence. It was only mentioned in passing.

#### Sell Triggers

- if insiders sell
- if results disappoint

> *"Det är bolagets ordförande och ytterligare ledamöter som har köpt aktier i den."*

---
